critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck primitive along its longitudinal axis to increase the hump length by 150%. Simultaneously, scale the vertical height of the front segment by a factor of 1.4 and apply a fillet radius of 2.5 units to the leading edge transition between the cockpit and the nose to ensure a smooth aerodynamic curve.

discrepancies.observed: A very short hump that ends almost immediately behind the cockpit.
discrepancies.reference: An elongated upper deck that extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck primitive

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively low and blends quickly into the main fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct, elevated section that rises sharply from the nose area.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase vertical height of the front upper-deck segment

discrepancies.observed: An abrupt transition between the cockpit and the hump.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous aerodynamic curve from the nose to the top of the deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: smooth/round the leading edge of the hump geometry

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck appears narrow and vertically oriented.
discrepancies.reference: A wide, spacious cabin section that maintains a consistent width for several meters.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase width of the upper-deck primitive
